name: echo-x-text-advisory
description: Vulnerable selection on a real repository: echo v4.15.4 requires golang.org/x/text v0.38.0 only indirectly, and GO-2026-5970 in it is reachable at symbol level. v0.39.0 fixes it and declares go 1.25.0, the repository's own directive, so the lowest fixing version is a minor upgrade of an indirect dependency with no source change. The live database changes over time, so the scenario checks this advisory and that nothing is introduced, not totals.
